# netbox_journal_entry (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/features/journaling/):

> A journal entry is a note that records a change or an event for an object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_journal_entry" "example" {
  assigned_object_type = "dcim.site"
  assigned_object_id   = netbox_site.example.id
  comments             = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assigned_object_id` (Number) The ID of the assigned object associated with the journal entry.
- `assigned_object_type` (String) The assigned object type of the journal entry.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the journal entry.

### Optional

- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `kind` (String) One of [info, success, warning, danger].
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_journal_entry.example 1
```
